svg.title: Model fit and node boundaries decide whether to start with data, tensor, pipeline, or expert parallelism.
svg.desc: If the model fits on one GPU, start with independent data-parallel replicas. If it fits within one node, test tensor parallelism inside the node and replicate the group if traffic requires it. If it spans nodes, test a tensor-and-pipeline combination against the interconnect and latency target. For mixture-of-experts models, add expert parallelism only when expert placement requires it, then benchmark the chosen combination at the target SLO.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: A starting heuristic for choosing parallelism

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Test the simplest combination that fits, then benchmark before committing.

svg.text: This is a starting heuristic, not a fixed rule — validate memory, communication, throughput, and latency on the target cluster.

svg.text: Large deployments often combine tensor parallelism within a node with pipeline parallelism across nodes.
